maya (devex): Quick proposal for CLI + SDK onboarding creds flow — want to get feedback before I open a PR. TL;DR: prefer short-lived, scoped ephemeral tokens by default for CLI onboarding and sample apps, with a clear env var precedence order and a 6mo deprecation for RW_API_KEY.

sam (sdk): +1 to ephemeral by default for CLI. Curious: how do we expect customers to do long-running server usage? refresh tokens or service keys?

maya (devex): Good q — for server/server-like workloads we keep long-lived service keys (project-scoped) but they should be explicit and created via the Console. CLI onboarding + local dev uses ephemeral auth via a refresh flow that exchanges a temporary auth code for a short-lived token.

eli (cli): Proposed env var conventions:
```
# Highest priority: explicit CLI-provided token
REDWOOD_TOKEN=eyJ...

# Next: per-project service key (explicit)
REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY=sk_proj_...

# Fallback deprecated old name
RW_API_KEY=...  # deprecated, will warn
```
We should document the exact precedence in the SDKs.

nora (security): Make sure we include an audience claim and scope in ephemeral tokens so they can't be reused across orgs/projects. Also we need audit events when a service key is minted.

maya (devex): Agreed. Also want CLI UX: when user runs `rw login` without env vars, CLI should open browser flow and write ephemeral token to `~/.redwood/credentials` with `REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT` metadata and expiry. If they have `REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY` set, skip interactive flow.

sam (sdk): SDK parity note: JS/Python/Go need to implement identical priority order and a single helper `from_env()` semantics. Also add a `REDWOOD_AUTH_DEBUG=1` flag for engineers so we can log which source won (no secrets).

eli (cli): Suggestion for rotation story: rotations-bot should announce upcoming service-key deprecations and trigger a graceful 30d token-rotation window for apps that rely on long-lived keys. For ephemeral tokens, CLI will auto-renew if refresh token present.

nora (security): Can we require service keys to be bound to an org:project scope string like `org:team-prod`? That would reduce blast radius. Also set default TTL 90d for service keys and make rotation recommended at 30d.

maya (devex): Yes to scope binding. For sample apps we should provide a helper script `scripts/obtain_local_token.sh` that calls the Console API to create a short-lived token and prints an `export REDWOOD_TOKEN=...` for quick dev.

sam (sdk): One DX bug I want to avoid: current SDKs treat ANY env var ending in "API_KEY" as credentials (too permissive). We should whitelist exact names only.

eli (cli): We'll add a linting rule in the CLI that warns when `RW_API_KEY` exists and suggests `REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY` or the interactive flow. Lint rule name: `cli-auth:deprecated-env`

maya (devex): Migration plan draft:
- Phase 1 (now): Add deprecation warnings when `RW_API_KEY` is detected in CLI/SDKs.
- Phase 2 (30d): Default onboarding flows switch to ephemeral tokens; Console shows a checkmark recommending ephemeral for devs.
- Phase 3 (90d): Block new service keys without scope metadata? (opt-in by default)
- Phase 4 (180d): Deprecate RW_API_KEY parsing, fail if only RW_API_KEY present; provide migration tool.

nora (security): Need timeline approval from legal/compliance for 180d deprecation. Also audit that our telemetry captures how many customers still have RW_API_KEY only.

sam (sdk): Tests: add e2e matrix where env var set -> SDK picks correct cred; cli login flow -> writes creds; sample app uses `REDWOOD_TOKEN` env var. I'll add integration tests in `sdk-integration/cred_priority.test.ts` and `cli/login.flow.test.ts`.

eli (cli): UX nit: when writing `~/.redwood/credentials` include `expires_at` and `scopes` and a `source` field (browser, oauth, service_key). That will help SDKs choose whether to auto-refresh.

rotations-bot: Reminder: scheduled service-key rotation window for org-42 starts in 18 days. See https://console.redwood.ai/rotations/org-42

maya (devex): Thanks — next steps: I'll open an RFC with env var precedence, sample scripts, and the deprecation timeline. @sam @eli @nora please add review comments in PR. If no objections, we'll land warning messages this week. :thumbsup:

sam (sdk): :thumbsup:

eli (cli): LGTM, will add tests.

nora (security): Will review RFC for scope/aud claims.

maya (devex): Filing RFC now.
